support.notes: Cartesian chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free engine: the web component props mapped to the same presets and engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset; hover/pointClick/plotClick/zoom events and a template ref handle (resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize). No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Bar chart
translationResources.description: Bars grouped side by side or stacked, with optional line overlays.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: One series of [category, value] tuples; the y axis always includes zero.

stacked.title: Stacked
stacked.description: stacked piles the series on top of each other.

labels.title: Value labels
labels.description: labels writes the value above every bar, with the y axis format, and leaves room for it above the tallest bar. Best with few bars, when exact values matter.

percent.title: 100% stacked
percent.description: percent scales every stack to 100% to compare the composition of groups of different sizes; the tooltip shows the number of answers and their share.

combo.title: Bars and line
combo.description: A series with type: "line" is drawn over the bars, here a 7-day average.

grouped.title: Grouped
grouped.description: Several series without stacked sit side by side in each category, here the monthly rainfall of three cities; Intl.NumberFormat writes the unit.

profit-loss.title: Profit and loss
profit-loss.description: Negative values grow downwards from zero; each datum sets its own color, green for a profit and red for a loss, and the y format shows the sign.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: Sort the data before passing it to rank the categories; Intl.DisplayNames gives the country names in the reader's language and showLabels writes the values.

target.title: Against a target
target.description: A dashed y line marks the weekly target and the bars that reach it are highlighted through their datum color.

drilldown.title: Drill down
drilldown.description: onPointClick on a quarter swaps the series for its three months, and a Button brings the quarters back; clicking a month writes its revenue in an aria-live output.

period-compare.title: Compare with last year
period-compare.description: A Switch sets hidden on last year's series to show or hide the comparison without changing the colors, and renderTooltip lists both years with the change in percent.

deployments.title: Deployments over time
deployments.description: Stacked bars on a time axis count the successful and rolled-back deployments of each day; rect annotations shade the weekends and a change freeze, and a summary gives the deployment frequency and change failure rate.

ev-charging.title: Cheapest hours to charge
ev-charging.description: Tomorrow's hourly electricity prices, split into three stacked series so that each bar takes the color of its price tier. A rect annotation follows the cheapest run of hours for the charging time picked in the Select, and the output compares its cost with charging on arrival.

BarChartProps.series: Series drawn as bars unless they set a type (e.g. a line overlay)
BarChartProps.stacked: Stacks the bars of every series instead of grouping them
BarChartProps.labels: Writes the value above every bar
BarChartProps.orientation: "horizontal" draws the bars from the left, the categories down the left side

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Tap a bar: onPointClick receives the quarter and its value.

stacked.title: Stacked
stacked.description: The Switch toggles stacked between stacked and grouped bars.

grouped.title: Grouped bars with labels
grouped.description: Two years side by side per region; labels writes the value above every bar.

stacked.title: Stacked bars
stacked.description: Sessions per device piled up for each day of the week.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
